## What this region is

Foundry's repo-wide conventions: how the monorepo is split into core, foundry and acp and what each may contain or import, how the code is mapped and navigated with atlas, and the design principles and common mistakes that every change must respect.

## What it exists for

- Decide which package or module code may live in or import from
- Use and keep the code map
- Know which role does what

## How people say these problems

A moment that says any of these, or something close, is this region's. Both voices: the user asking or correcting, and the agent describing what it is about to build.

- which package does this go in
- can core import this
- is this import allowed here
- put this in core so Oracle can use it
- where is this concept in the code
- I added a new file
- the atlas check is failing
- who does the actual coding
- should this be a Warden
- which role gets the capable model
- who does the actual coding work
- where does the correction detector live
- feedback is only what I give with slash feedback
- the ACP agent shouldn't run turns itself
- where's the list of models and capabilities
- where does a new provider go
- the atlas coverage check is failing
- the native session that edits files
- find every file that's part of classify
- I'll write a correction detector in foundry
- don't auto-detect corrections by default
- I'll import the runtime into the ACP package
- I'll hardcode which models support tools
- agents importing from the viewer
- I'll put the API call in core
- I'll add a Warden subclass for security
- stamp the header on this moved file
- I'll run the work through our own agent loop
- I'll grep the whole repo for it
- share correction detection with Oracle
- talk to the daemon from foundry-acp
- Oracle needs model fitness without foundry
- I'll import the viewer helper into providers
- providers do HTTP, keep them out of core
- name a Warden in settings by hand
- add a new concept to the registry
- generate a map of the codebase
- core shouldn't make decisions
- advise and guard for one domain

## When this is not your domain

These mention this region's words but belong elsewhere; the answer is no, and the region named answers instead.

- which model should this Warden or classifier run on → decision-hosts
- I'll write a summarizer to compress the session when it gets long → chorus
- run the full check before I merge → testing-vcr
- add a new OpenAI-compatible provider for this model → models-providers
- foundry-acp needs to handle a new host request → acp
